name: KISS/KILL
source:
For a year, you've been working alongside the criminal organization The Syndicate, while actually owing your loyalty to their biggest rivals, the Triad. Now, as your reputation within the Syndicate grows, the boss invites you out for a twilight cruise and dinner on his yacht. But can you keep up the charade in such close quarters?

Lie, flirt, and probe your way through a dinner conversation, where missteps could cost you your life, but the right moves may grant you more than just survival.

[From [url=https://dragontheorygames.itch.io/kisskill]itch.io[/url]]
